name: SM_g1_clock3
note: Three bands, no signals: lane, then objectives, then siege. A pure clock.

name: SM_g1_clock2
note: Two-state control: lane the opening, then siege. If this matches the rest, the extra states are decoration.

name: SM_g1_map
note: Reads the tower count only: ahead -> siege, behind -> ward, level -> lane. No hysteresis, so it may flap.

name: SM_g1_map_commit
note: SM_g1_map with a three-round commit once a state is entered.

name: SM_g1_objective_window
note: Sieges by default and goes to the pit only while something is up. Two states.

name: SM_g1_fight
note: Groups after a won fight, sieges when ahead, wards when two champions down; otherwise lanes.

name: SM_g1_ap_lead
note: Reads the economy: ahead on income -> siege, behind -> take objectives, level -> lane.

name: SM_g1_full
note: Every state in play, in priority order: close a low Nexus, contest an objective, press a won fight, siege when ahead or late, ward when well behind.
